convention: Orientation names indicate the front of the door; the game camera stays fixed.

north.directionMeaning: Direction of the door front normal
north.label: Nord

frame.support: directly on the existing side walls, no additional jambs

north.floorPolicy: Unchanged normalized motif in WORLD axes, trimmed to the current wall feet. Never rotate paving.
north.doorFaces: One centered physical leaf, equal front/rear recess, with plank seams, two bands and a handle on EACH face. Hardware remains in its true face plane.

visibility.method: Inverse-transform world points and camera ray into the source convex prisms
